Add recursive self-improvement loop with feedback capture, insights, and template generation

Introduces five interconnected mechanisms that let agent-rig learn from its own output:

1. Feedback capture (src/feedback.mjs) - saves JSON records of what users approve/skip/modify after every config generation session
2. Template generation (src/template-generator.mjs, src/commands/generate-template.mjs) - creates reusable templates from high-approval sessions
3. Self-analysis (src/analyze.mjs, src/commands/self-improve.mjs, skills/self-improve/) - agent-rig can analyze itself to propose improvements
4. Heuristic insights (src/commands/insights.mjs) - aggregates feedback to surface high/low-value recommendations
5. Quality scoring (src/scoring.mjs) - tracks per-template approval rates with tiered quality labels

New CLI commands: insights, generate-template, self-improve
User data stored in ~/.claude/agent-rig/ (feedback + user templates)
Templates system now searches both bundled and user directories
